title: AI Trading isn't that hard if you are willing to stop thinking about months of data and base it around the last few days
author: AmWoz
selftext: I built a AI fully autonomous crypto trader it took me 3 months to tune and have made between 8-24% per day since for the last 30 days starting with $100usd my goal is 100k in in 100 days it could still fail. But if you have any questions I'm happy to answer

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
8-24% a day on $100 is the easy part though. at a few thousand the same orders start moving the book on whatever small coins it trades, and the fills you're getting now stop existing.

I'd watch average slippage per trade as the account grows, more than the daily %. that's usually where these break.

replies.author: AmWoz
replies.body: Yeah I agree I have modelled it prior and at certain points I has change in strategy ensuring it can continue on its current path

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: a strategy that switches itself at certain points is the one I'd trust least in a backtest though. it gets to pick the switch points knowing how the chart ended.

replies.author: AmWoz
replies.body: I'll let you know where it's at when I finish the 100 days because granted I understand your logic but the actual set up itself is built around making the right decision at the time. Leveraging both deterministic classification and a frontier LLM

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: fair, post it when you get there. I'd keep one line per trade with the price you expected and the price you got, that's the first thing to move as the account grows.

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Could you share a verified record, like exchange statements with timestamps? At 8% to 24% a day, compounding for 30 days would turn $100 into roughly $1,000 to $63,000, so it would help to know whether the gains are compounded or measured on a fixed amount. A system tuned for three months on the most recent data can look great on that period and break when conditions change, so I'd keep the rules frozen and track every trade net of fees and slippage. Cymetica's EventTrader (event timing for macro releases) is one source you could use to check whether the gains depend on a few news days.

replies.author: AmWoz
replies.body: I will share it all on day 100 of the challenge. Nah frozen rules is asking for failure like there's consistent changes each day from the AI plus my own input which I see something like my background is in finance and data. But every note thought and change is tracked within a MD file so I can share you all the data and approach etc. I don't want to give away too much whilst I'm working on its challenge so I don't accidentally saturated the market lol but it's sitting around 26k currently
